programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
programs.desc: This Caribbean mecca for rock legends was envisioned by famous Beatles' producer George Martin; although many legendary records were made there, the studio had to close after a series of natural disasters rocked the small island.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
programs.desc: A luxurious skyscraper in the center of a bustling Bangkok metropolis is now an eerily derelict ghost tower; experts investigate and uncover a devastating financial crisis entangled in plots of a murder mystery that led to the development's demise.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
programs.desc: The bizarre remains of an Old West mining town lie mysteriously deserted high in the mountains of Maggie Valley, N.C.; experts investigate an abandoned ghost town theme park that some local residents believe carries a curse.
